subject: [PATCH v5 03/22] iomap: decouple simple direct I/O reads from iomap_dio_rw

2026-07-29.patch_summary: This patch decouples simple direct I/O reads from the iomap_dio_rw function by creating a new function, iomap_dio_read_simple, which can be called explicitly by file systems for cases they can handle. This change allows dropping checks for incompatible features and enables inlining of the initial part of the simple direct I/O read fast path. As a result, performance issues related to the pending iomap_iter_next conversion are addressed.
